title: La muela
goal: Get a tooth dealt with while explaining the pain
culture: Same diagnostic shape as the moto workshop: where it is, and when it happens. Between cuando como and con el frío he already knows what he will find, and he will do it today.

beats.good: Muela is a molar and diente is a front tooth. Pointing is allowed and expected.
When it hurts is the diagnosis, exactly as it was with the noise on the moto: aquí atrás, cuando freno.
Between that and cuando como he already knows what he is going to find when he gets in there.

beats.es: Se puede salvar... pero le va a doler un tiempo.
beats.objective: Tell him to take it out
beats.good: Sáquemela — take it out. It is your decision and he will do it this afternoon, which is either reassuring or not depending on the day you are having.
